mapper.sql: o.id, o.user_id, o.group_id, o.title, o.price, o.reason, o.substitute, o.extra_note, o.images, o.category, o.visibility, o.approve_mode, o.duration_hours, o.status, o.pass_count, o.reject_count, o.vote_count, o.target_votes, o.comment_count, o.hot_score, o.expire_time, o.settle_time, o.audit_status, o.audit_remark, o.is_top, o.create_time
mapper.select:
select , u.nick_name as user_nick_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, u.show_vip as user_show_vip, g.name as group_name, v.result as my_result, case when v.id is null then 0 else 1 end as my_voted, case when o.user_id = #{userId} then 1 else 0 end as mine from apply_order o left join app_user u on u.id = o.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join apply_group g on g.id = o.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' left join apply_vote v on v.order_id = o.id and v.user_id = #{userId} and v.del_flag = '0' where o.del_flag = '0' and o.audit_status = '1'
and o.group_id = #{groupId}
and o.visibility = '0'
and o.status = #{status}
order by o.is_top desc, o.hot_score desc, o.create_time desc
and o.status = '0' order by o.is_top desc, o.expire_time asc, o.create_time desc
order by o.is_top desc, o.create_time desc

select , u.nick_name as user_nick_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, u.show_vip as user_show_vip, g.name as group_name, mv.result as my_result, case when mv.id is null then 0 else 1 end as my_voted, case when o.user_id = #{userId} then 1 else 0 end as mine from apply_order o left join app_user u on u.id = o.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join apply_group g on g.id = o.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' left join apply_vote mv on mv.order_id = o.id and mv.user_id = #{userId} and mv.del_flag = '0'
where o.del_flag = '0' and mv.id is not null
where o.del_flag = '0' and exists (select 1 from apply_favorite f where f.order_id = o.id and f.user_id = #{userId})
where o.del_flag = '0' and o.user_id = #{userId}
and (o.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.reason like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and o.status = #{status}
order by o.create_time desc
select ifnull(nullif(o.category, ''), 'other') as name, count(*) as value from apply_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.audit_status = '1' group by name order by value desc limit 8

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as cnt from apply_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date order by date asc
select ifnull(sum(price), 0) as amount, count(*) as cnt from apply_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '2'
